description: Add ApplicationPackage, PackageClaimUsage, GenerationVariant, EvalAssertion, EvalGoldenPackage, EvalRun models to prisma/schema.prisma. Add packageId field + relation to existing GenerationRecord model. Add variants GenerationVariant[] relation to GenerationRecord. Seed 8 initial Tier 1 assertions from requirements.md. This covers Tasks 5.1 and 5.4 from the spec.
steps: Add ApplicationPackage model to prisma/schema.prisma with fields: id, jobId, name, disclosureLevel (default 'standard'), status (default 'draft'), submittedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, generations GenerationRecord[], claimUsages PackageClaimUsage[]. Indexes on jobId, status.

Add PackageClaimUsage model with fields: id, packageId (FK to ApplicationPackage with onDelete:Cascade), claimId, documentType, overridden (default false). Unique constraint on [packageId, claimId, documentType]. Indexes on packageId, claimId.
Add GenerationVariant model with fields: id, generationId (FK to GenerationRecord with onDelete:Cascade), variantLabel, tradeoff, text, chosen (default false). Index on generationId.

Add EvalAssertion model with fields: id, tier (Int), assertType (String), target (String), claimId (nullable String), documentTypes (String[]), correctionDate (nullable DateTime), active (default true), createdAt. Indexes on tier, active.

Add EvalGoldenPackage model with fields: id, name, roleFamily, sector, postingText, postingDate (DateTime), claimSnapshot (Json), firstGeneration (String), submittedVersion (String), editDiff (String), approvedAt (DateTime), createdAt. Indexes on roleFamily, sector.

Add EvalRun model with fields: id, goldenPackageId (nullable String), modelId, promptVersion, temperature (Float), factScore (nullable Float), voiceScore (nullable Float), editDistance (nullable Float), anchorDiscrimination (nullable Float), generatedOutput (String), assertionResults (Json), createdAt. Indexes on goldenPackageId, createdAt.

Modify existing GenerationRecord model: add packageId (nullable String), add package relation (ApplicationPackage? @relation(fields: [packageId], references: [id])), add variants GenerationVariant[] relation. Add index on packageId.

Create seed script at scripts/seed-eval-assertions.ts that creates the 8 Tier 1 assertions from the table in requirements.md: (1) contains 'REDACTED_LINKEDIN_URL', (2) not-contains 'REDACTED_ALT_NAME', (3) contains '30 million customer genomes', (4) not-contains 'REDACTED_FORBIDDEN_PHRASE_1', (5) not-contains 'REDACTED_FORBIDDEN_PHRASE_2', (6) not-contains 'REDACTED_FORBIDDEN_PHRASE_3', (7) not-contains 'REDACTED_FORBIDDEN_PHRASE_4', (8) not-contains 'securing' / 'secured' attached to her as completed act. Make it idempotent.
Run prisma generate to verify schema compiles correctly.
Add a package.json script entry: 'seed:eval': 'tsx scripts/seed-eval-assertions.ts'
acceptance_criteria: All six new models exist in schema with correct columns, relations, and indexes
GenerationRecord has packageId field + ApplicationPackage relation + variants GenerationVariant[] relation
PackageClaimUsage has unique constraint on [packageId, claimId, documentType]
Seed script creates 8 initial Tier 1 assertions and is idempotent
npx prisma generate succeeds without errors
findings: Node.js was not pre-installed in the sandbox; installed node@22 via mise (MISE_NODE_VERIFY=0 to bypass gpg). Bun was available but prisma CLI requires node. All 171 existing tests pass. Build succeeds cleanly.
